risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure or worn clutches/gears.
risks.proof: A video showing the input shaft being rotated manually and the corresponding output response in different gear selections.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate or stamped part number on the casing.

risks.risk: Faulty transmission control solenoids or damaged wiring harness.
risks.proof: A diagnostic scan report if tested, or a multimeter resistance test of the pins on the electrical connector.

risks.risk: Contaminated internals due to open lines or storage on dirt.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the metal identification tag or stamped serial number on the gearbox housing.
Photo of the rear output section to confirm it is a 4WD model.

response.reason: The specific model and year of the Ford Expedition are not identified; gearboxes for this vehicle range from 4-speed to 10-speed units with vastly different values. Identification of the part number is required for an accurate worst-case price.
